name: HRSG duct burner (supplementary gas firing)
description: Burner installed in the gas-turbine exhaust duct to burn additional natural gas in the remaining oxygen and raise steam output. Two main forms are standard round gas burners and linear grid burners spanning the duct. Installed in the transition duct before the lead tube bank or between superheater stages, with flame holders, pilots, igniters and flame scanners.
